rawProcedureCalls.sqlTemplate: SELECT task_id, run_id, attempt, created FROM absurd.spawn_task(${this.queueName}, ${taskName}, ${input}::jsonb, ${admissionOptions}::jsonb)
rawProcedureCalls.reason: Task admission owns the one parameterized vendor procedure call that shares the caller's product transaction.
Task event admission owns the one parameterized vendor procedure call that shares a persisted product outcome's transaction.

exemptions.reason: Admission-time recall-query derivation reads one frozen conversation message inside the existing RunAdmissionTransaction, matching every sibling session-assembly source; migrate together with those sources to a policy-owned repository.

The approval lifecycle owns one existing caller-opened serializable transaction across the approval row, run pause, ToolInvocation transition, and result delivery; its ToolInvocation writes delegate to the declared transaction repository helpers while the remaining approval-row delegates stay here until the approval unit of work is extracted.
bootstrap chat start must create the child conversation before the parent pin inside one atomic write; extract a dedicated onboarding UnitOfWork with the next onboarding persistence boundary change.

Run admission already owns its serializable transaction and duplicate-recovery semantics; this authorization migration binds the central decision to that transaction without changing durable run persistence, while repository extraction remains a separate execution-safety refactor.

Terminal reporting owns one caller-opened transaction across the attempt fence, pending-tool check, terminal transition, timeline event, and child delivery; extract its dedicated repository only when replacing the remaining run lifecycle owner.
